# Reports Directory

All validation and explainability reports are auto-generated here.
PNG and text files are excluded from git (see `.gitignore`).

## Files (auto-generated by running the pipeline)

| File | Generated By | Description |
|------|-------------|-------------|
| `01_performance_curves.png` | `validate.py` | ROC and Precision-Recall curves |
| `02_stability_ks_test.png` | `validate.py` | Score distribution stability (KS test) |
| `03_drift_psi.png` | `validate.py` | Feature drift (Population Stability Index) |
| `04_bias_fairness.png` | `validate.py` | Disparate impact analysis by group |
| `05_threshold_optimization.png` | `validate.py` | Precision/Recall/F1 vs threshold |
| `06_shap_global_importance.png` | `explain.py` | Global SHAP feature importance bar chart |
| `07_shap_beeswarm.png` | `explain.py` | SHAP beeswarm summary (direction + magnitude) |
| `08_shap_local_explanation.png` | `explain.py` | Single transaction waterfall explanation |
| `feature_importance.csv` | `explain.py` | Full feature importance rankings |
| `validation_summary.txt` | `validate.py` | Text summary of all validation results |

## Regenerating reports

```bash
python src/validate.py   # performance, stability, drift, bias, threshold
python src/explain.py    # SHAP global, beeswarm, local explanation
```
